name: B10-0129/2026 (S&D) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Turkey to stop using national security claims to arrest, detain or ban foreign journalists and Christian missionaries. It asks the European Commission to press Turkey harder on press freedom and to look closely at the barriers Christians face in worship, education and state surveillance. It also asks Turkey to meet its international commitments on religious tolerance.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request and a statement of concern, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Foreign journalists and Christian minorities in Turkey, plus Turkish journalists.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and Turkey's government and parliament.
